purpose: Inputs for the WebP/AVIF encoder comparison and the SSIM-gate wrapper test. The 8 src/ images are a SUBSTITUTE for the team's product photos (no photo hosts reachable): 4 bundled scikit-image 0.26.0 sample photos (no pooch download) + 3 synthetic text-on-photo banners + 1 flat product-like render.

src/photo_astronaut.png.origin: skimage.data.astronaut(), NASA Great Images database (Eileen Collins)

src/photo_chelsea.png.licence: CC0, photographer Stefan van der Walt

src/photo_rocket.png.origin: skimage.data.rocket(), SpaceX DSCOVR launch (bundled as JPEG, decoded to PNG by gen_photos.py)

src/banner_text_chelsea.png.origin: gen_synthetic.mjs: photo_chelsea + crisp SVG text overlay via sharp composite

src/flat_product_box.png.origin: gen_synthetic.mjs: flat-colour SVG packaging render with sharp edges and small label text, rasterised by sharp

generators: gen_photos.py (run with the trial venv: scikit-image==0.26.0)

seeded_defects.location: whole image (400x400 deterministic per-pixel random RGB noise, LCG seed 12345)
seeded_defects.what: content no lossy encoder can reproduce at site qualities; WebP q80 scores SSIM 0.55 and AVIF q60 0.89 against the source
seeded_defects.check: wrapper SSIM gate: any output with SSIM < --min-ssim (0.92 in the test) must be listed in `failed` and the exit code must be 1

controls.expect: passes the gate at every setting tried (WebP q80 SSIM 0.991, AVIF q60 0.999)
passes at --min-ssim 0.92 (WebP q80 0.953, AVIF q60 0.957); a finding here at 0.92 = false positive
same copies inside the seeded dir; must not be listed in `failed`

note_on_threshold: The 0.97 RGB-SSIM bar from the brief is above today's JPEG-80 export (7/8 src images score 0.92-0.955 at JPEG-80), so a run on src/ at --min-ssim 0.97 with the adopted qualities exits 1 by design; 0.92 is the lowest JPEG-80 score on these fixtures and is used as the 'not worse than today' gate in the control/seeded test.
